besluite.fout: '... in, maar ook' leaves the contrast without its first half, so 'maar ook' hangs after a plain positive clause.
besluite.rede: 'nie net ... nie, maar ook' is the natural Afrikaans form and keeps the same list and meaning.

besluite.fout: 'oor en oor op sy eie' can be read as 'on its own', the sense 'op sy eie' carries in the planet definition.
besluite.rede: 'in sy eie wentelbaan' is the usual Afrikaans preposition with wentelbaan and removes the misreading; the planet still moves along its own orbit.

besluite.fout: The predicative superlative lacks 'die', unlike the lesson's own 'is die verste'.
besluite.rede: 'is die naaste aan die Son' is the standard form, the meaning is unchanged and 'van Mercurius tot Mars' stays intact.

besluite.fout: The predicative superlative lacks 'die', right beside 'Neptunus is die verste'.
besluite.rede: Adding 'die' gives the standard form and makes the two parallel sentences match without changing the meaning.

besluite.fout: 'al agt planete' drops the article Afrikaans uses after a number in this construction.
besluite.rede: 'al agt die planete' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form, with no change in meaning.

besluite.fout: 'Hulle neem langer om' copies English 'they take longer to'.
besluite.rede: 'het ... langer nodig om' is natural Afrikaans and matches the 'het ... nodig' the next two sentences already use.

besluite.fout: 'Hulle neem langer ... om' copies English 'they take longer to'.
besluite.rede: Same fix as change 6, keeping both comparisons and the lesson's wording consistent.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Die Aarde het een maan' and 'dit is ons eie Maan' are two full sentences, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'Die getalle' has no clear referent, because the paragraph gives 'baie' rather than numbers.
besluite.rede: 'Die getal mane' names what changes, adds no fact and keeps 'soms' and the reason intact.

besluite.fout: The compound is hyphenated, but there is no vowel clash to justify it.
besluite.rede: 'yswêreldjies' is the correct spelling of the compound as one word.
'Die gordel skei so ...' is normal Afrikaans word order, so fronting 'So' is a lateral move.
